meta.title: Green circles appeared in the Saudi desert. Then they died 🛰️ #shorts
meta.description:
From the late 1980s, centre-pivot farms pumped fossil water from an aquifer thousands of years old to grow wheat in the Arabian desert. From orbit they look like green coins. When the water ran low, Saudi Arabia phased out wheat farming and the circles began to fade.

Watch our planet change in seconds. Accelerated geographic shifts, urban growth and climate overviews from a clean satellite perspective.

📍 Wadi As-Sirhan, Saudi Arabia · 1987 → 2024
🎬 Stylized satellite reconstruction based on real-world change.

Was it worth it? Yes or no 👇
